topic: How does defocused feed array placement optimize coverage versus scan loss in DBF architectures?
consensus_response: Defocused feed arrays optimize coverage by reducing scan loss and minimizing interference. This is achieved through strategic element selection and geometry optimization, enhancing coverage efficiency while maintaining robust performance against individual element failures.  Compared to conventional antennas, defocused arrays offer slightly reduced overall gain but significantly lower spillover losses, ensuring enhanced network resilience and efficient signal reception.
reference_context: Defocused feed arrays enhance coverage by spreading signals evenly across directions, reducing scan loss and increasing robustness against individual feed failures. This approach improves coverage efficiency through optimized beamforming techniques and minimizes interference from multiple antennas.
